description: The Zenodo record publishes wind measurements of thunderstorm outflows from monitoring stations at Northern Mediterranean ports. The currently resolving version lists a location text file, an event index and a ZIP of recorded events, under CC BY 4.0 with free public access. The article describes full-scale downburst and gust-front records collected for wind engineering, not only synoptic storms. These time series can help check non-stationary wind-load models for port cranes, roofs and other exposed structures. Station sites and event sampling are uneven; the archive does not provide a continent-wide wind hazard probability map. Users should read the event index, sampling units and quality flags before fitting structural demand curves. The concept DOI cited in the article now resolves to a newer version DOI, so version selection matters. It complements data-ihdata-ihcantabria-wave-hindcasts as a different marine-weather stressor. No event archive was downloaded. These wind records can serve as boundary conditions in structural wind-load simulations for port and building assets.
